scope: Verify raw physical source files, permissions, and linkage across PhysioNet PTB-XL, Chapman, and MIMIC-IV-ECG
checks_performed: File existence, paired metadata inspection, missing record enumeration, header readability
quantitative_results: 37,046 raw catalog records scanned; 89 Chapman files missing from source distribution; 36,957 paired records confirmed usable
passed_checks: All PTB-XL (21,799) and MIMIC (5,000) records intact; paired metadata matched
failed_checks_and_defects: 89 raw Chapman files missing from source tarballs (JS00045, JS00078, etc.)
unresolved_issues: Missing 89 raw files unrecoverable without external re-download
supported_conclusions: Catalog universe established at 37,046; usable paired universe at 36,957
unsupported_conclusions: Does not verify signal numerical quality or absence of flatlines

audit_name: Module 1 Signal Quality Control and Preprocessing Audit
scope: Inspect signal calibration, unit scaling (mV), duration (10s), sampling rate (100 Hz), flatline and NaN checks
checks_performed: Finite value scan, amplitude bound check (|V| < 10 mV), flatline check (std > 1e-4), duration check (1000 samples)
quantitative_results: 36,957 records processed; 69 records failed QC (2 PTB-XL, 16 Chapman, 51 MIMIC); 36,888 eligible modeling records established
passed_checks: 36,888 records passed all P_5 quality criteria; output shape (12, 1000) float32 verified
failed_checks_and_defects: 69 records exhibited severe flatlines, non-physiological DC offsets, or corrupt values
unresolved_issues: None; failed records excluded and recorded in excluded_records.csv
supported_conclusions: 36,888 modeling records are numerically valid, finite, and standardized in physical mV
unsupported_conclusions: Does not audit clinical diagnosis correctness

scope: Tri-state mapping rules (1=positive, 0=confirmed negative, NaN/mask=False=unknown) across 8 target diseases
checks_performed: Mapping rule verification, positive criteria adherence, conflict detection, observation mask synchronization
quantitative_results: 36,888 records mapped; 100% equivalence between label NaN and observation_mask=False confirmed
passed_checks: Zero unmasked unobserved targets; strict NORM criteria enforced; no positive overlap between NORM and target pathologies
failed_checks_and_defects: MIMIC labels rely on automated GE Marquette 12SL statements rather than cardiologist review
unresolved_issues: Automated vs physician annotation disparity across cohorts preserved by design
supported_conclusions: Eight-label tri-state clinical multi-label schema is mathematically and logically sound
unsupported_conclusions: Does not prove automated MIMIC labels have zero false positives

audit_name: Module 1 Duplicate Signal and Cross-Split Leakage Audit
scope: Compute SHA-256 byte hashes of all 36,888 signal arrays across partitions to detect leakage
checks_performed: Exact signal hash matching within and across splits and source cohorts
quantitative_results: 36,888 scanned; 36,875 unique signal hashes; 0 duplicates in PTB-XL; 0 in MIMIC; 0 cross-cohort; 13 identical signal pairs in Chapman (9 cross-split, 4 within-train)
passed_checks: Zero patient leakage in PTB-XL and MIMIC; patient quarantine intact
failed_checks_and_defects: Chapman lacks native patient IDs; record-ID fallback resulted in 9 identical recording pairs falling into different folds
unresolved_issues: Chapman source data lacks clinical patient identifiers to eliminate duplicate recordings
supported_conclusions: Leakage is strictly bounded to the 9 Chapman pairs and fully documented in the freeze contract
unsupported_conclusions: Cannot claim complete patient-level independence for the Chapman cohort

audit_name: Module 1 Final Freeze and Acceptance Audit
scope: Comprehensive end-to-end verification of record counts, splits, hashes, and freeze marker
checks_performed: Re-load all 36,888 physical .npy files, verify split manifest, verify checksum manifest, verify MODULE1_FROZEN.json
quantitative_results: 36,888 files verified; checksum manifest sha256 47bb4547d8a39f4a... matches MODULE1_FROZEN.json
passed_checks: 100% acceptance criteria satisfied; all artifacts declared immutable
supported_conclusions: Module 1 permanently frozen; ready for Module 2 progressive lead degradation
unsupported_conclusions: Does not grant authorization for downstream test split unblinding
